title: The schism on the Pentex Board
summary: A divided Board after three deaths.

claims.text: A small but fast-growing split runs through the Pentex Board of Directors after three members were killed by the claws of a single Garou.
No one knows which Wyrms the replacement members truly serve, so the whole Board has turned nervous and paranoid.
Pentex is like a many-armed kraken: a hard-won victory over it often turns out to have cut off only one tentacle tip, a subsidiary of a subsidiary.

title: The Monkeywrenchers
summary: Young Garou who strike at Pentex directly.

claims.text: Some Garou have at last put a name, and sometimes a face, to the enemy that hid behind Pentex, and young werewolves have rallied to fight it.
They are known as Monkeywrenchers, a name now spoken by Garou and Wyrm servants alike.

title: The Hines Plan
summary: How Pentex strips the humanity from its fomori.

claims.text: New fomori still hold mostly human aims and wishes, so Pentex works to change them quickly.

Under the Hines Plan, now spreading to many Pentex sites, drugs and conditioning, including near-silent music piped through hidden speakers, wear away kindness, remorse and empathy and leave a sly intelligence; a fomor whose treatment fails is destroyed.

Most of these fomori are made surgically by Magadon, and they dig ant-farm warrens beneath their facilities; intruders must make Perception + Alertness rolls at difficulty 8 or get lost and lose dice on later Perception rolls.

title: Enzo Giovanni on the Board
summary: A Giovanni drawn into the Wyrm’s service.

claims.text: Enzo Giovanni won the third open seat on the Pentex Board by entirely legitimate means, through shifting vote deals and a smear campaign, with Kathryn Mollett as the only ally there.
Mahsstrac, the Urge Wyrm of Power, sensed Enzo’s hunger for power and traded more of it for loyalty; Enzo is now almost wholly subservient, while ties to the clan weaken.
Pentex bought Irish Eyes Enterprises, nearly shutting the Giovanni out; the Venetian Giovanni have not yet branded Enzo a traitor and know nothing of the Wyrm’s hold on Pentex.
